name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - maint/**

  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Dry-Run'
        default: 'true'
        required: false

env:
  # are we on a release branch?
  DO_REALEASE: ${{ github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch || github.ref_name == 'next' || startsWith(github.ref_name, 'maint/')}}
  DRY_RUN: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # zero stands for full checkout, which is required for semantic-release
          filter: blob:none # we don't need all blobs, only the full tree
          show-progress: false

      - uses: containerbase/internal-tools/setup@e540d5d9aa823f009633b93823f0d69caa13ac34 # v5.0.11
        with:
          save-cache: true
          checkout: false
          pnpm-cache: |
            node_modules
            packages/*/node_modules

      - name: Check dry run
        run: |
          if [[ "${{github.event_name}}" == "workflow_dispatch" && "${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}" != "true"  ]]; then
            echo "DRY_RUN=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          elif [[ "${{env.DO_REALEASE}}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "DRY_RUN=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - run: pnpm build

      - run: pnpm semantic-release --dry-run ${{env.DRY_RUN}}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - maint/**
      - renovate/*
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - uses: containerbase/internal-tools/setup@e540d5d9aa823f009633b93823f0d69caa13ac34 # v5.0.11
        with:
          save-cache: true
          pnpm-cache: |
            node_modules
            packages/*/node_modules

      - run: pnpm build

      - run: pnpm eslint -f gha

      - run: pnpm prettier

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version:
          - 22
          - 24

    permissions:
      id-token: write # required for codecov OIDC

    env:
      NODE_OPTIONS: --trace-warnings

    steps:
      - uses: containerbase/internal-tools/setup@e540d5d9aa823f009633b93823f0d69caa13ac34 # v5.0.11
        with:
          save-cache: true
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          pnpm-cache: |
            node_modules
            packages/*/node_modules

      - run: pnpm build

      - run: pnpm test:unit

      - run: pnpm test:integration

      - name: Codecov test results
        if: github.event_name != 'merge_group' && !cancelled()
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f # v6.0.2
        with:
          use_oidc: true
          report_type: test_results
          flags: node${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ runner.os }}

      - name: Codecov coverage results
        if: github.event_name != 'merge_group'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f # v6.0.2
        with:
          use_oidc: true
          flags: node${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ runner.os }}

  # Catch-all required check for test matrix
  success:
    needs:
      - lint
      - test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 1
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Fail for failed or cancelled lint tests
        if: |
          needs.lint.result == 'failure' ||
          needs.lint.result == 'cancelled'
        run: exit 1

      - name: Fail for failed or cancelled test tests
        if: |
          needs.test.result == 'failure' ||
          needs.test.result == 'skipped'
        run: exit 1

name: devcontainer
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '**'
      - '!main'
      - '!next'
      - '!maint/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - maint/**
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review

jobs:
  devcontainer-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.repository_owner != github.event.pull_request.head.repo.owner.login && github.event.pull_request.draft != true)
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          show-progress: false

      - name: Build and run dev container task
        uses: devcontainers/ci@513af61f4de4f75d37e4438f184ba4358f0fc1ca # v0.3.1900000450
        with:
          push: never
          runCmd: pnpm build
          env: |
            GITHUB_TOKEN
            SKIP_GITHUB_ISSUES
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SKIP_GITHUB_ISSUES: 'true'

name: Upload Database

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */4 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: containerbase/internal-tools/setup@e540d5d9aa823f009633b93823f0d69caa13ac34 # v5.0.11
        with:
          pnpm-cache: |
            node_modules
            packages/*/node_modules

      - run: pnpm build

      - run: pnpm start
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

    "lint-staged": "17.3.0",
    "npm-run-all2": "8.0.4",
    "prettier": "3.9.6",
    "semantic-release": "25.0.9",
    "ts-node": "10.9.2",
    "tsx": "4.23.12",
    "typescript": "6.0.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.67.0",
    "vitest": "4.1.10"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.12.0",
    "pnpm": "^11.0.0"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.21.0"

# osv-offline

## Packages

| [`@renovatebot/osv-offline`](./packages/osv-offline)                 | [![](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@renovatebot/osv-offline?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@renovatebot/osv-offline)               |
| [`@renovatebot/osv-offline-db`](./packages/osv-offline-db)           | [![](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@renovatebot/osv-offline-db?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@renovatebot/osv-offline-db)         |
| [`@renovatebot/osv-offline-updater`](./packages/osv-offline-updater) | [![](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/renovatebot/osv-offline?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/renovatebot/osv-offline/releases/latest) |
